tess: Quick sync — I'm proposing a lightweight 'sieve' step in the onboarding pipeline to catch obvious compatibility/latency failures before we run full bench.
samir: +1. Can you sketch what the sieve would run vs the current smoke? :eyes:
lisa: Curious about false positive rates. We don't want to block models that only fail noisy checks.
tess: Right. Idea is: 3 ultra-cheap checks (binary/fast) -> kv-cache sanity, matmul-kernel mismatch probe, quantized I/O shape check. If any fail, mark 'needs-investigation' rather than hard block.
kai: Example kv-cache probe? short snippet?
tess: ```
# kv-cache probe pseudo
input = "hello" * 4
warm_ctx = repeat(input, 4)
call(model, warm_ctx)
call(model, warm_ctx + " world")
# expect cache delta ~ <threshold tokens
```
samir: That helps. For matmul/kernel mismatch, do you want us to run a single forward at seq_len=1024 and assert no OOM + runtime fallback to slow path?
lisa: Also quantized I/O shape check should assert dtype/shape round-trip with tiny batch.
benchbot: note: running these on a single small instance costs ~0.04 GPU-min on average, compared to 3 GPU-min for a short bench.
ingest-bot: FYI — current ingest flow tags models with metadata that we can use to skip sieve for already-verified families.
tess: Tradeoffs: faster feedback vs potential manual triage load. I think 'needs-investigation' queue should be small if thresholds tuned conservatively.
kai: How conservative? If threshold too loose, we get noisy failures; too strict, we add manual work.
samir: Proposal: initial thresholds = 3x observed median of recent 50 models, then decay to 2x after 2 weeks of telemetry.
lisa: Nice adaptive approach. Also add a metric: percent of sieve-fails that become bench-pass after triage (false-positive rate). Keep target < 10%.
tess: Ops: add a flag `sieve.enabled=true/false` per-tenant so Dedicated customers can opt-out if they want full bench always.
samir: Implementation note: make sieve run on CPU-first where possible (quant and shape checks), only spin GPU for kv-cache probe.
benchbot: Implementation ETA: I can add probes to the smoke harness if you drop the exact probes in a PR.
tess: I'll draft PR with the three probes + metrics + triage queue hook.
lisa: +1 from me. Can we also add a short playbook for triage engineers with prioritized checks?
tess: Yes — I'll add a triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally with the same tokenizer 2) run canonical golden inputs 3) capture kernel fallback logs 4) escalate to infra if kernel mismatch persists.
kai: ping @samir once PR is up and I'll run initial tuning on sample models.
samir: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
